notes.title: Update (2.0)
notes.content:
- LEVEL EDITOR: Create, share and play custom levels from around the world now!
- Create, Load, Featured, Search and Recent Functionality for Level Editor
- Accounts (Create your own Profile)
- New Level 20 "Momentum"
- 5 New Characters
- New Death Animations
- New Victory Songs
- New Menu Songs
- 'Random Every Time' customize options for Jump Animation
- 'Random Every Time' customize options for Scene Animation
- 'Random Every Time' customize options for Death Animation
- 'Random Every Time' customize options for Victory Song
- 'Random Every Time' customize options for Main Menu Song
- New power-ups: X2 Teleport Board, X2 Jumppad
- Major Bug Fixes
- Editor Guide
- Custom Songs from Tasty Network and Argofox
- Improved Graphics/Textures
- Fan Art Button
- All collision blocks apply for all vehicles now!
- New Levels UI displaying Level Length, Song Name
- Updated Level Complete UI displaying Song Name
- New "Next Level" Button
- 5 New translations (Albanian, Russian, Chinese (Simplified) and Korean)
- Full Version is now available for iOS and Android as well!

And most importantly ... tons and tons of bug fixes! There is probably a lot more to this update log but this kinda sums it down. Thanks for playing guys =)

Kas

notes.title: Update (1.70)
notes.content:
(HUGE UPDATE!)
- New Ghost Level 17 "Shurk - Absolution"
- 10 New Characters (5 Lenny Box Characters)
- 5 New Spaceships
- Customize Trophy Sound (End of Level)
- 14 New Trail Colors (Mix) + 14 New Power-up Color (mix)
- 3 New Backgrounds + Colors
- 2 New Victory Songs "Dex Arson - Gangsta" and now default "Valesco - Cloud 9"
- 2 New Menu Songs "Shurk - The Maze" and  "Nameless Warning - Things in Life"
- New Practice Default Song "Shurk - Within your Mind"
- Updated Practice Mode (Turns red on hit)
- Now displays "Deaths" at end of Practice
- Graphical Improvements
- Use arrow keys to select level
- Press Up key to enter a level
- Shows Artist Name at End of Level

Thanks for playing everybody!

EVENT:
First 3 people to complete and post Absolution on YouTube get to enter special Level Editor Beta!

- Kas
